auraskills.granite.command.backup.info_b:
Granite /backup (Sprint 60, read the manual):
— create|save: writes ONE timestamped .yml under the plugin backups/ folder using common BackupProvider (saves online users first, then all UserState from StorageProvider.loadStates).
— Includes: per-user skills, XP, mana, stat/trait modifiers (same idea as user data).
— Does NOT: copy full config tree, messages/, loot, menus, items registry files, or raw userdata/*.yml; use a world or full datadir backup for that.
— MySQL/SQL: uses the same loadStates path as file; very large player counts can hit automatic_backups.max_users and skip create.
— Not in this sprint: restore/load, delete, schedules, or SQL dump tooling. Bukkit used backup save|load; load is not exposed here.
